jobs.jd:
DECATHLON DIGITAL 

L'entité Data de Decathlon coordonne l'ensemble des activités visant à l'accélération et la généralisation de l'usage et la valorisation des données.

Decathlon vise à devenir la meilleure plateforme digitale de sport et l'écosystème ouvert le plus performant au monde. Nous voulons permettre à nos clients de vivre l'expérience Decathlon à travers de nombreuses expériences locales centrées sur le sport en connectant de nombreux acteurs et services tiers, de manière sécurisée et performante.

Nos équipes digitales à Lille, Paris et Nantes - qui rassemblent plus de 5000 collaborateurs - sont unies pour construire et faire évoluer des produits digitaux avec l'objectif de toujours offrir la meilleure valeur à nos utilisateurs. Présent dans plus de 70 pays, Decathlon est engagé dans l'innovation, la durabilité et la satisfaction des clients.

Tu participeras à des projets qui ont le potentiel de définir l'avenir du sport : une vraie opportunité de façonner l'industrie grâce aux données et à l'IA !

Pour renforcer nos équipes Data & IA, nous recrutons un(e) Stagiaire Data Scientist - Forecast (H/F) pour un stage de fin d'études conventionné de 6 mois, à partir de février 2027, basé à Paris.

LE SUJET DE STAGE

Dans un environnement retail en constante évolution, nos équipes en magasin ont besoin d'outils prédictifs performants pour anticiper leur activité et adapter leur organisation au quotidien. Aujourd'hui, l'optimisation des plannings, la prévision d'affluence et l'anticipation de la charge de travail représentent des défis majeurs d'échelle et de précision.

Au sein de nos équipes Data & IA, ton objectif sera de participer à l'amélioration, à l'évaluation et au passage à l'échelle de nos modèles de prévision déjà en production, en explorant notamment l'apport des nouveaux modèles de fondation temporels et tabulaires.

L'enjeu : réaliser un état de l'art des solutions émergentes, adapter ces modèles à nos problématiques réelles complexes et structurer un framework de benchmark robuste pour valider scientifiquement les meilleures approches.

TES RESPONSABILITÉS

Tu interviendras sur l'ensemble de la chaîne de valeur du projet, de la recherche appliquée jusqu'à la mise en production :

  • Veille et état de l'art scientifique : Explorer et évaluer les nouvelles approches de modèles de fondation pour séries temporelles et données tabulaires (TSFM / TabFM).
  • Spécialisation et adaptation : Entraîner, spécialiser (fine-tuning) et adapter ces modèles de fondation aux contraintes opérationnelles réelles du retail.
  • Framework de benchmark et d'évaluation : Concevoir un cadre de test standardisé et structurer des jeux de données réels pour comparer objectivement les performances des différents modèles.
  • Optimisation des modèles prédictifs : Participer à l'amélioration de nos modèles prédictifs actuellement en production.
  • Collaboration et valorisation : Restituer tes travaux de manière claire et évaluer, selon les résultats et tes appétences, l'opportunité d'une publication scientifique ou technique.

Le périmètre technique :

  • Python, SQL
  • PyTorch ou TensorFlow, Hugging Face, benchmarks de modèles de fondation (ex. GIFT-Eval, TIME, fev-bench)
  • Databricks, Spark, dbt
  • Airflow (Astronomer), AWS (S3, ECR, ...)
  • Jupyter, Git, Docker

 CE DONT TU AURAS BESOIN POUR RÉUSSIR

  • Formation : Tu es étudiant(e) en dernière année d'école d'ingénieur ou en Master 2 spécialisé en Mathématiques Appliquées, Data Science, Intelligence Artificielle, Informatique ou équivalent, à la recherche d'un stage de fin d'études de 6 mois.
  • Socle technique : Tu maîtrises Python, SQL et Git, et tu possèdes de solides bases en statistiques, Machine Learning et Deep Learning.
  • Communication : Tu as d'excellentes compétences interpersonnelles, analytiques et de présentation, avec la capacité de vulgariser des concepts techniques complexes de manière simple pour des équipes métiers.
  • État d'esprit : Tu aimes explorer et résoudre des problèmes, clarifier proactivement les besoins, travailler en autonomie et prendre des responsabilités lorsque cela est nécessaire.
  • Culture : Tu es sensible à l'impact de la pratique du sport et tu as envie de rejoindre une entreprise à impact positif (#Tech4Good).
  • Cerise sur le gâteau : Tu as déjà travaillé sur des problématiques liées au retail ou manipulé des datasets complexes de séries temporelles en environnement réel.

 CE QUE NOUS OFFRONS

  • Un environnement de travail moderne dans nos bureaux Decathlon Digital à Paris
  • La possibilité d’innover et d’avoir de l’impact grâce à la data et à la technologie
  • Liberté de choix de l'outil de travail (Mac, Windows)
  • Une équipe projet locale connectée à un réseau international
  • Montée en compétences et mentorat (diversité de projets, technologies de pointe, certifications, événements)
  • Formations internes et externes
  • Gratification de stage et possibilité de pré-embauche selon opportunités

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.jd: Do you thrive on complex problems and want to work at the forefront of AI? Join Cefetra Group’s new AI Innovation Hub as an AI Engineer and shape how AI creates value across our international trading business, from agents and workflows integrated with our core systems to the skills and ways of working that make them stick. Who we are Cefetra Group comprises several trading companies in the agricultural sector and the food ingredients industry, with leading brands in the ingredients market. Together, we employ approximately 800 people across 39 offices in 17 countries worldwide. We work closely together to provide our customers with the best possible service. Together with our suppliers, we develop strong supply chains and create value by sourcing raw materials and supplying them to the international food, animal feed and energy industries. Behind that sits real complexity: global commodity flows, volatile markets, intricate contracts and logistics, and data spread across many entities and systems. That is exactly where AI can make a decisive difference, and we are building the capability to make it happen. The role As an AI Engineer in the AI Innovation Hub, part of the Group Digital & Technology team, your goal is to build Cefetra Group’s AI capability and set the standard for how AI is designed and used across our entities. You’ll deliver AI solutions, from agents and workflows to knowledge bases, that teams across Cefetra Group can apply to augment their work, while helping colleagues build the skills to use them. You’ll work directly with process owners and business leaders to find where AI creates the most value. The AI Innovation Hub is just getting started, so together with the Group Digital & Technology team you’ll shape its direction from the ground up: which opportunities it pursues and how it delivers them. You’ll also work with Builders and Changemakers, colleagues in our entities who build AI solutions and drive adoption, to share what works and show business leaders what AI makes possible. Your responsibilities include Run discovery workshops to identify bottlenecks, value and exceptions. Assess use cases against readiness, team commitment, expected value and reuse potential. Build AI workflows and agents using company data. Take prototypes all the way to robust, production-grade solutions that teams rely on in their daily work. Integrate AI solutions with ERP, finance and operations systems, designing integrations that move safely from read-only access to controlled write-back. Test solutions against real business scenarios. Set the deployment patterns, tool choices and safeguards that others across Cefetra Group build on. Deliver hands-on workshops, from practical AI topics such as Claude Skills for non-technical colleagues to technical topics such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) for Builders and create materials Changemakers can use to train their peers. Prepare demos of working use cases for leadership briefings. Who you are To succeed at Cefetra Group, you love complexity and combine deep technical curiosity with a pragmatic, collaborative approach. You work well both independently and with people at all levels of Cefetra Group. You take ownership end to end and move easily between governance, technical details and business priorities. You also meet the following requirements: You have at least four years of experience in a technical, customer-facing, consulting or product role. You’ve built and evaluated large language model (LLM) workflows, agents or applications in production. You have hands-on experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector search, indexing, knowledge bases, context engineering and orchestration. You follow AI developments closely, from new models to agentic patterns and protocols, and know how to turn new capabilities into practical value. You have full-stack development experience with Python or TypeScript, including APIs, authentication, data transformation and enterprise integrations. You’re fluent in English and have led workshops for non-technical audiences. What we offer A unique opportunity to help Cefetra Group grow and become part of a dynamic and entrepreneurial team within an established multinational. We’re always open to discussing your individual needs. Here’s what we offer. Access to frontier AI models and the room to experiment with new tools, techniques and ways of working. Flexible working hours and hybrid working, as well as opportunities to learn and develop. An excellent remuneration and benefits package, including a competitive base salary, holiday allowance, an attractive bonus scheme and 28 days of annual leave. An office in one of the finest locations in central Rotterdam, overlooking the Maas and the Erasmus Bridge, with plenty of social activities and excellent coffee. If this sounds like you Interested in a conversation to further explore and enquire? Please apply below and we will contact you a.s.a.p. Or contact via +31 6 2520 3984 or Recruitment, consulting other temp/secondment agency? We appreciate the interest, but we seek all our candidates directly. We understand that you would like to present your candidates our interesting positions, but this is not how we have structured our recruitment process. jobs.title: Data Scientist - Core Analytics
jobs.jd: Ripjar builds software and data products that help our customers combat serious financial crime. Our technology identifies criminal activity such as money laundering and terrorist financing, and helps customers enforce sanctions at scale. Data is at the heart of everything we do. Much of it is multilingual text: an archive of over 10 billion news articles in 150+ languages, going back more than 30 years, alongside government sanctions, watchlist data and ownership data on 250 million organisations from corporate registries worldwide. Working at this scale means our problems are as much computational as statistical. Comparing hundreds of millions of entities, or running models over billions of documents, is intractable without the right algorithms, so careful thinking about complexity and efficient implementation is part of the job. Data Science Team Our data science team builds and maintains the models behind Ripjar ’s screening product. Much of the work is NLP, including named entity recognition, risk classification, entity resolution, duplicate detection, summarisation and geolocation, and we're increasingly using LLMs to push this further. The team sits within Engineering and works in short cycles, shipping improvements regularly and measuring their impact. Because our customers operate in heavily regulated environments, our models face a high level of scrutiny, so every change needs to be well tested, explainable and backed by evidence. This is a great time to join a growing team of talented technologists and data scientists building products that change how financial crime is detected and prevented. We're keen to hear from experienced data scientists at a range of levels, and the scope of the role will reflect what you bring. What you'll be doing: We're looking for an experienced Data Scientist who is motivated to solve customer problems and enjoys owning them end to end, from: Framing the problem and exploring the data Building and evaluating models Deploying, scaling and maintaining the solution in production You will work with language models, machine learning tools and large-scale distributed clusters. This role suits a data scientist with a strength in NLP and a genuine interest in computing: someone who thinks about algorithmic complexity, memory and throughput as naturally as model accuracy. You'll enjoy shipping a model that adds real value quickly and iterating on it based on real-world feedback. Ripjar equips staff with the very best AI tooling to help them work effectively via judicious review. Some recent work Ripjar ’s data scientists have been involved in: Entity resolution across tens of millions of news articles, at a scale where naive pairwise comparison is intractable. Using LLMs to summarise news articles linking an entity to financial crime (or other similar risks), with LLM judges to monitor performance. Using LLMs to run automated quality assurance on our data outputs at scale. Key Tasks: Analyse large datasets using Ripjar ’s distributed data processing infrastructure to identify patterns and inform new analytics and models. Develop and evaluate machine learning models, including LLM-based approaches, to enhance Ripjar ’s products. Design algorithms and pipelines that stay tractable at scale, making sensible trade-offs between accuracy, latency and compute cost. Work with Data Engineers and the wider engineering team to integrate models into our products and pipelines, then own their performance, efficiency and maintenance in production. Design statistical tests, evaluate results, and document models and methodologies to the standard our regulated customers expect. Work with Product and, from time to time, directly with customers to understand their needs, explain analytics, models and test results, and help resolve questions about how our models behave in practice. Requirements Experience delivering data science solutions end to end, from prototype to production, including testing, deployment and long-term maintenance. Strong computer science fundamentals: algorithms, data structures and computational complexity, and how to apply them to make large-scale problems tractable. Proficiency in Python and writing production-quality, performant code, particularly with machine learning and data science libraries such as PyTorch, scikit-learn, numpy and scipy. Proficiency using Natural Language Processing techniques to solve problems, ideally including Large Language Models. Working knowledge of statistics. Experience working with large-scale data processing systems such as Spark and Hadoop. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Keen to use AI-assisted coding tools (e.g. Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) to speed up development and experimentation. A habit of keeping up to date with developments in AI, including ML, NLP and LLMs, and judging which new techniques and tools are worth applying to real problems. Cloud-based experience is desirable. Experience using or implementing MLOps approaches is desirable. Benefits Why we think you’ll enjoy it here: Competitive base salary DOE 25 days annual leave + birthdays off, rising to 30 days after 5 years of service Christmas shutdown Fully remote or office based working 35 hour working week Private Family Healthcare Life Assurance Employee Assistance Programme Salary sacrifice pension scheme Enhanced maternity/paternity pay There is a well-stocked pantry with food, snacks and drinks when in the office Originally posted on Himalayas

Dans un environnement retail en constante évolution, nos équipes en magasin ont besoin de s'appuyer sur des analyses fiables et rapides pour piloter leur activité au plus près des attentes de leurs clients locaux. Aujourd'hui, l'exploitation conjointe de nos données internes et des dynamiques de chaque territoire représente un défi majeur d'échelle et d'accessibilité.

Au sein de nos équipes Data & IA, ton objectif sera de participer à la conception et au passage à l'échelle d'un assistant IA agentique d'aide à la décision pour notre réseau de magasins.

L'enjeu : transformer des données complexes et multi-sources en analyses claires, fiables et directement exploitables par des équipes métiers non techniques, à travers une expérience conversationnelle intuitive.

TES RESPONSABILITÉS

Tu interviendras sur l'ensemble de la chaîne de valeur Data & IA, de la donnée brute jusqu'à l'interaction utilisateur :

  • Structuration et gouvernance de données multi-sources : Consolider des indicateurs clés issus de notre Datalake interne et intégrer de nouvelles sources de données externes via des pipelines automatisés.
  • Conception de workflows agentiques : Développer et orchestrer des agents IA capables de croiser nos sources de données pour générer des synthèses pertinentes, identifier des opportunités et formuler des recommandations actionnables.
  • Développement d'une expérience conversationnelle : Mettre en place la couche d'interaction entre les utilisateurs et les agents IA pour garantir des échanges fiables et fluides.
  • Évaluation et industrialisation : Concevoir un cadre d'évaluation pour mesurer la fiabilité et la pertinence des réponses et industrialiser la solution pour un usage à grande échelle.
  • Collaboration produit et métier : Échanger avec les parties prenantes pour affiner leurs besoins, faire évoluer la solution à partir de leurs retours et restituer clairement les avancées techniques.

Le périmètre technique :

  • Python, SQL 
  • LLMs & Agentic workflow : frameworks (ex. LangGraph, Google ADK...), protocoles & outils (MCP, A2A, Tool Calling, RAG), évaluation & observabilité (ex. MLflow, Langfuse)
  • Databricks, Spark, dbt
  • Airflow (Astronomer), AWS (S3, ECR, ...)
  • Jupyter, Git, Docker

CE DONT TU AURAS BESOIN POUR RÉUSSIR

  • Formation : Tu es étudiant(e) en dernière année d'école d'ingénieur ou en Master 2 spécialisé en Data Science, Intelligence Artificielle, Informatique ou équivalent, à la recherche d'un stage de fin d'études de 6 mois.
  • Socle technique : Tu maîtrises Python et SQL, tu es à l'aise avec les bonnes pratiques de développement (Git) et tu as une forte appétence pour l'IA générative et les architectures agentiques.
  • Communication : Tu as d'excellentes compétences interpersonnelles, analytiques et de présentation, avec la capacité de vulgariser des concepts techniques complexes de manière simple pour des équipes métiers.
  • État d'esprit : Tu aimes explorer et résoudre des problèmes, clarifier proactivement les besoins, travailler en autonomie et prendre des responsabilités lorsque cela est nécessaire.
  • Culture : Tu es sensible à l'impact de la pratique du sport et tu as envie de rejoindre une entreprise à impact positif (#Tech4Good).
  • Cerise sur le gâteau : tu as déjà mené un projet autour des LLMs / agents IA / RAG, ou travaillé sur des problématiques liées au retail et à la donnée à grande échelle.

CE QUE NOUS OFFRONS

  • Un environnement de travail moderne dans nos bureaux Decathlon Digital à Paris
  • La possibilité d’innover et d’avoir de l’impact grâce à la data et à la technologie
  • Liberté de choix de l'outil de travail (Mac, Windows)
  • Une équipe projet locale connectée à un réseau international
  • Montée en compétences et mentorat (diversité de projets, technologies de pointe, certifications, événements)
  • Formations internes et externes
  • Gratification de stage et possibilité de pré-embauche selon opportunités

jobs.jd:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

An Overview of this role

As a Data Scientist at GitLab on the Enterprise Analytics team,  you’ll be a trusted analytical partner to Sales, Revenue Operations, and Finance, helping define how we measure go-to-market performance and where we invest to grow. You’ll apply statistical, experimentation, and machine learning methods to forecast outcomes, explain what drives activation, conversion, expansion, and retention, and size opportunities. You’ll also support the company-level reporting and GTM performance views that executives use to run the business, covering consumption, ARR, and first orders.

What you’ll bring

  • Hands-on experience building agentic workflows with AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, OpenCode, or similar), including connecting agents to the right context, tools, and platforms such as MLflow, and evaluating their output for accuracy and reliability.
  • Experience working in a B2C company working with motions and metrics, including Consumption, CRR, ARR, and Churn & Contraction
  • Self-motivated and self-managing, with strong organizational skills
  • Ability to use GitLab and to thrive in a fully remote organization

The Enterprise Analytics team builds the trusted data products and insights behind GitLab’s Company wide sales, revenue, and finance reporting. We work across the business on metrics including First Orders, pipeline, CRR, ARR, and other key indicators, helping leaders make informed decisions and teams understand how their work contributes to GitLab’s growth.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist (Healthcare)

This analytics-driven project helps health insurance companies (payers) reduce avoidable medical costs, improve healthcare efficiency, and quantify potential savings on a custom analytics platform. You will deliver hands-on data science—turning payer healthcare data into predictive models and insights that identify avoidable cost and savings opportunities, building GenAI and advanced ML components , and supporting workload migrations across platforms. This is a remote-first position with a required overlap of US working hours (2–6 PM CET) . Responsibilities Explore, prepare, and model payer healthcare data (e.g., claims, member, provider, and eligibility data). Develop, train, and validate predictive and statistical models supporting affordability value mining, including anomaly detection and savings quantification. Engineer features, build scalable data pipelines, and take models into production. Develop GenAI and advanced ML components where they add value (e.g., RAG, transformer-based models). Support the migration of notebooks, models, and pipelines from the existing system to the target platform, including validation of results. Partner with the MLOps Engineer, clinical/business domain experts, and stakeholders to move models into production, monitor performance, and translate business questions into analytic solutions. Senior-level data scientist with 5+ years of relevant experience. Strong expertise in predictive modeling, anomaly detection, feature engineering , scalable pipelines, and model productionization. Solid statistical modeling and hypothesis-testing expertise, plus a deep understanding of the full ML lifecycle. Advanced Python and SQL skills, with strong knowledge of ML frameworks such as SciPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field (or equivalent experience). Strong problem-solving skills, keen attention to detail, and clear communication in English. Practical exposure to GenAI projects and frameworks (e.g., RAG applications, vector databases, LangChain, LlamaIndex, agentic frameworks). Experience with probabilistic modeling (e.g., Bayesian networks, pyMC, pgmpy), reinforcement learning, and migrating data science/ML workloads between platforms. Experience with healthcare risk, cost, or utilization modeling, coding standards ( ICD, CPT, HCC ), MLOps/DataOps practices, and HIPAA / PHI handling. Highlights If you are passionate about Healthcare Data Science, Predictive Modeling, and GenAI , this role with our client offers an exciting opportunity to drive impactful cost-saving analytics! jobs.jd: AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. AWS Infrastructure Services Science (AISS) researches and builds machine learning models that influence the power utilization at our data centers to ensure the health of our thermal and electrical infrastructure at high infrastructure utilization. As a Data Scientist, you will work on our Science team and partner closely with other scientists and data engineers as well as Business Intelligence, Technical Program Management, and Software teams to accurately model and optimize our power infrastructure. Outputs from your models will directly influence our data center topology and will drive exceptional cost savings. You will be responsible for building data science prototypes that optimize our power and thermal infrastructure, working across AWS to solve data mapping and quality issues (e.g. predicting when we might have bad sensor readings), and contribute to our Science team vision. You are skeptical. When someone gives you a data source, you pepper them with questions about sampling biases, accuracy, and coverage. You maintain rigorous standards and take ownership of the outcome of your data pipelines and code. You do whatever it takes to add value. You don’t care whether you’re building complex ML models, writing blazing fast code, integrating multiple disparate data-sets, or creating baseline models - you care passionately about stakeholders and know that as a curator of data insight you can unlock massive cost savings and preserve customer availability. You have a limitless curiosity. You constantly ask questions about the technologies and approaches we are taking and are constantly learning about industry best practices you can bring to our team. You have excellent business and communication skills to be able to work with product owners to understand key business questions and earn the trust of senior leaders. jobs.jd:
DECATHLON DIGITAL 

L'entité Data de Decathlon coordonne l'ensemble des activités visant à l'accélération et la généralisation de l'usage et la valorisation des données.

Decathlon vise à devenir la meilleure plateforme digitale de sport et l'écosystème ouvert le plus performant au monde. Nous voulons permettre à nos clients de vivre l'expérience Decathlon à travers de nombreuses expériences locales centrées sur le sport en connectant de nombreux acteurs et services tiers, de manière sécurisée et performante.

Nos équipes digitales à Lille, Paris et Nantes - qui rassemblent plus de 5000 collaborateurs - sont unies pour construire et faire évoluer des produits digitaux avec l'objectif de toujours offrir la meilleure valeur à nos utilisateurs. Présent dans plus de 70 pays, Decathlon est engagé dans l'innovation, la durabilité et la satisfaction des clients.

Tu participeras à des projets qui ont le potentiel de définir l'avenir du sport : une vraie opportunité de façonner l'industrie grâce aux données et à l'IA !

Pour renforcer nos équipes Data & IA, nous recrutons un(e) Stagiaire Data Scientist - Computer Vision pour un stage de fin d'études conventionné de 6 mois, à partir de février 2027, basé à Paris.

LE SUJET DE STAGE

Dans un environnement retail en constante évolution, l'analyse visuelle en magasin représente un levier majeur pour optimiser l'excellence opérationnelle et mieux comprendre l'expérience client.

Au sein de nos équipes Data & IA, ton objectif sera de concevoir et prototyper des solutions innovantes basées sur la vision par ordinateur en exploitant différents flux visuels (images et vidéos), dans le strict respect des normes de confidentialité (RGPD).

L'enjeu : allier recherche algorithmique de pointe et impact concret sur le terrain, à travers des cas d'usage variés tels que l'analyse automatisée des rayons (détection de ruptures, conformité de mise en rayon) et la compréhension des parcours en magasin (estimation de pose, cartes de chaleur).

TES RESPONSABILITÉS

Tu interviendras sur l'ensemble de la chaîne de valeur du projet, de la recherche appliquée jusqu'à la démonstration de valeur :

  • Veille et état de l'art scientifique : Explorer et évaluer les dernières approches en Computer Vision (détection d'objets, segmentation, estimation de pose, modèles de fondation visuels).
  • Détection et analyse de rayons : Développer des algorithmes de détection d'objets, de segmentation et de classification pour analyser les photos de linéaires (identification d'articles, détection de ruptures visuelles, conformité de mise en rayon et supports de communication).
  • Analyse de flux et estimation de pose : Prototyper des modèles d'estimation de pose pour modéliser les dynamiques et parcours en magasin, tout en garantissant le strict respect du RGPD.
  • Exploration de données et entraînement : Préparer des jeux de données complexes (images et vidéos) et entraîner ou adapter des modèles de l'état de l'art (ex. YOLO, ViT, modèles de fondation, MediaPipe).
  • Collaboration et valorisation : Restituer tes avancées et résultats à travers des visualisations et des démonstrations (PoC) auprès des équipes techniques et métiers.

Le périmètre technique :

  • Python, SQL
  • PyTorch ou TensorFlow, OpenCV, modèles & librairies de Computer Vision (ex. YOLO, ViT, Foundation Models, MediaPipe)
  • Databricks, Spark, dbt
  • Airflow (Astronomer), AWS (S3, ECR, ...)
  • Jupyter, Git, Docker

CE DONT TU AURAS BESOIN POUR RÉUSSIR

  • Formation : Tu es étudiant(e) en dernière année d'école d'ingénieur ou en Master 2 spécialisé en Computer Vision, Data Science, Intelligence Artificielle, Informatique ou équivalent, à la recherche d'un stage de fin d'études de 6 mois.
  • Socle technique : Tu maîtrises Python, SQL et Git, et tu possèdes de solides bases en Machine Learning, Deep Learning (PyTorch ou TensorFlow) et Computer Vision (ex. OpenCV, YOLO, ViT).
  • Communication : Tu as d'excellentes compétences interpersonnelles, analytiques et de présentation, avec la capacité de vulgariser des concepts techniques complexes de manière simple pour des équipes métiers.
  • État d'esprit : Tu aimes explorer et résoudre des problèmes, clarifier proactivement les besoins, travailler en autonomie et prendre des responsabilités lorsque cela est nécessaire.
  • Culture : Tu es sensible à l'impact de la pratique du sport et tu as envie de rejoindre une entreprise à impact positif (#Tech4Good).
  • Cerise sur le gâteau : Tu as déjà travaillé sur des problématiques liées au retail ou manipulé des datasets complexes d'images/vidéos en environnement réel.

CE QUE NOUS OFFRONS

  • Un environnement de travail moderne dans nos bureaux Decathlon Digital à Paris
  • La possibilité d’innover et d’avoir de l’impact grâce à la data et à la technologie
  • Liberté de choix de l'outil de travail (Mac, Windows)
  • Une équipe projet locale connectée à un réseau international
  • Montée en compétences et mentorat (diversité de projets, technologies de pointe, certifications, événements)
  • Formations internes et externes
  • Gratification de stage et possibilité de pré-embauche selon opportunités

DECATHLON DIGITAL

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.jd: About the role This is a hands-on senior role. You will write the core code, set the engineering standard for how we build agents, and work directly with clients to turn their workflows into acceptance criteria an agent can be tested against. If you have shipped a LangGraph system to production and can walk us through what broke and how you fixed it, we want to talk to you. What you'll build The runtime Design and build reusable agent runtimes in Python on LangGraph and LangChain, with clean interfaces for models, tools, memory, and integrations. Build stateful workflows with conditional routing, parallel branches, subgraphs, and human approval steps. Add multiple agents only when evaluation results justify the complexity. Reliability Implement durable checkpointing, pause and resume, timeouts, and cancellation. Make retries safe with idempotency keys, deduplication, and reconciliation when the outcome of an external action is unknown. Tools, context, and memory Build tool integrations with validated schemas, scoped permissions, authentication, and structured error handling across enterprise APIs and data systems. Engineer context and memory: retrieval, summarization, context selection, token budgets, retention, and tenant isolation. Evaluation and observability Build evaluation datasets and automated checks for business outcomes, tool-use correctness, policy compliance, and recovery, allowing for valid alternative execution paths. Gate every model, prompt, tool, and graph change on regression results. Instrument agents with LangSmith or equivalent tracing, then use traces to improve task success, latency, and cost per completed workflow. Security Implement prompt-injection defenses, authorization checks, secrets handling, audit trails, and approval controls for sensitive actions. Sandbox code execution where required. Delivery and leadership Own production delivery with backend and platform teams: APIs, streaming, containers, CI/CD, monitoring, incident response, and runbooks. Review code, mentor engineers, and translate client workflows into testable acceptance criteria. What you bring 8+ years of software engineering , including owning production systems from design through operation and hands-on AI/ML application work. 2+ years building LLM applications with LangChain , and at least one LangGraph system you shipped and ran in production. You can explain its architecture, how it failed, how you evaluated it, and what improved. Deep LangGraph knowledge: state schemas, reducers, nodes and edges, conditional routing, subgraphs, checkpointers, interrupts, and persistence. Fluent in current LangChain APIs for tool calling, structured outputs, retrieval, and middleware. Agent harness experience: extending Deep Agents or a comparable harness, including middleware, planning, subagents, filesystem access, and sandboxed execution. Model Context Protocol (MCP): building and securing MCP tool servers, integrated with enterprise identity and access controls. Retrieval engineering: permission-aware RAG, hybrid search, reranking, and retrieval evaluation. Strong Python: async, typing, testing, API design, and maintainable service architecture. Backend and distributed-systems fundamentals: PostgreSQL, queues, concurrency, retries, idempotency, and failure handling. Real experience with LLM failure modes: unreliable tool calls, context limits, nondeterminism, rate limits, and regressions after model or prompt changes. You have used evals and traces to find and fix them. Observability: OpenTelemetry instrumentation alongside LangSmith or equivalent agent tracing. Cloud delivery: Docker, automated testing, and CI/CD on AWS, GCP, or Azure. AI-native development: you work in an AI-enabled software development lifecycle, using coding agents for design, implementation, testing, and review, with the judgment to verify their output and the habits to make a team faster with them. Clear communication: you can explain tradeoffs to engineers and clients and own delivery without close supervision. Originally posted on Himalayas

Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job As a member of the AI model team, you will drive innovation in training and optimizing multimodal agents with a focus on real-world, interactive deployment. Your work will span the full agent development lifecycle - from data curation, interactive sandbox environments, and training pipeline design to model evaluation and optimization - with the goal of building multimodal agentic models that are both highly capable and practical to deploy locally at scale. You will work across a wide spectrum of multimodal architectures integrating perception, reasoning, and tool execution across digital environments, applying state-of-the-art research to improve visual grounding, multi-step task completion, and adaptability to unseen interfaces. We expect you to bring a research-driven mindset combined with strong engineering discipline - someone who can identify the right technique for a given problem, implement it rigorously, and measure its impact clearly. You will work closely with a small, high-caliber team where your contributions will have direct and meaningful impact. If you are passionate about pushing the boundaries of what multimodal agentic AI can achieve in production environments, this is your opportunity. Responsibilities Conduct end-to-end research and engineering on multimodal agentic models capable of perceiving, reasoning, and acting across real-world digital environments - including desktop operating systems, web browsers, and mobile devices. Design and scale post-training and online reinforcement learning pipelines (SFT, multi-turn GRPO/PPO) across multi-node GPU infrastructure, covering asynchronous rollouts, reward design, deterministic/learned verifiers, and safeguards against reward hacking. Architect high-concurrency interactive sandboxes (VMs, containers, and emulators) with fast snapshotting, deterministic resets, and reproducible evaluation frameworks to measure multi-step task completion and visual grounding. Build and optimize local agentic harnesses that coordinate multi-model orchestration, memory, planning, and cross-device task execution. Research and implement test-time adaptation and continual learning methods to enable rapid generalization to unseen applications and dynamic user interfaces. Develop scalable multimodal agentic datasets, including synthetic trajectory generation, fine-grained UI grounding, and automated trajectory filtering and verification. Drive model efficiency and local deployability on consumer hardware via knowledge distillation, quantization, and runtime optimization without degrading grounding or reasoning accuracy. Translate frontier multimodal agentic research into production improvements, contribute to open-source ecosystems, and publish findings in top-tier AI conferences where applicable. Requirements Degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field (MS/PhD preferred), or equivalent practical research and engineering experience. Strong hands-on experience training or post-training multimodal/vision-language models (SFT, distillation, or online RL such as GRPO/PPO) with measurable gains on agentic, visual grounding, or reasoning benchmarks. Proficiency in Python, PyTorch, and distributed training or high-throughput rollout/inference infrastructure (e.g., FSDP/Megatron, Slurm, verl, vLLM/SGLang). Deep hands-on in one or more of: online agentic RL & verifiers, high-concurrency OS/browser/mobile sandboxing, local agentic harnesses or test-time adaptation. jobs.jd: ⌘Role Overview The Data Scientist is the first hire on the team whose job is to put machine learning into production , not just into a notebook. You'll build models that power product and other live flows sometimes surfaced to users in real time, not just reported on in a dashboard a week later. The first flagship project is about personalization across the user journey: a model that decides, per user, what offer to show, wired directly into the product and lifecycle experience rather than sitting in a warehouse table. From there, you'll extend the same muscle: model → API → product surface to other high-leverage moments in the user journey. You'll work hand-in-hand with Product, Engineering and Lifecycle marketing to ship models as features, not as reports. This is also a foundational role for the team's infrastructure: most of what Data does today is batch (dbt, Lightdash, BigQuery); you'll help establish our first real-time low-latency serving patterns on GCP and work closely with engineering on this. ⌘Key Responsibilities 1. Production ML Development Build, validate, and ship ML models (propensity, pricing/discount optimization, personalization, churn/LTV) that go live in the product, not just proof-of-concept notebooks. Own the full lifecycle: problem framing, feature engineering, training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, retraining. Write production-grade code (tested, versioned, reviewed) — you'll be shipping alongside Engineering, held to their bar. 2. Personalization across the journey: from paywall to lifecycle Design and ship the personalized discounting model: who gets what offer, and why, served at the moment of the paywall decision. Partner with product on machine learning experiment design (A/B, holdouts) to prove causal lift of the models, not just correlation. Build the measurement framework so pricing/discount decisions are defensible to finance and leadership. 3. ML Infrastructure & MLOps (GCP) Stand up our first low-latency model serving pattern on GCP (e.g., Vertex AI endpoints, Cloud Run, or equivalent) Define the feature pipeline pattern: what's precomputed in BigQuery/dbt vs. what needs to be fresh/real-time via Pub/Sub or similar. Set up model monitoring: drift, staleness, prediction quality so a live model doesn't silently degrade. 4. Product & Engineering Partnership Sit close to Product and Engineering, not just Data this role is measured by what ships to actual users, not just notebooks Translate a product problem ("how might we reactive lapsed payers") into a modeling problem, and a model output into an API contract Engineering can build against. Document handoffs clearly enough that Engineering can own the serving layer long-term without you as a bottleneck. 5. Experimentation & Causal Inference Design uplift/causal models where "who responds to a discount" matters more than "who churns" . Run and interpret experiments that isolate the model's actual incremental impact on revenue/retention. Design the experimentation program for improving data science and machine learning models with the same rigour we use across our already ongoing experimentation programs ⌘Expected Outcomes Personalized discounting model live in production , serving real paywall decisions to real users: shipped end-to-end, not a prototype sitting in staging. A documented, reusable low-latency serving pattern established on GCP (Vertex AI endpoints or Cloud Run) — the next model doesn't require rebuilding this from scratch. Proven incremental lift on a core business metric (paywall conversion, discount margin efficiency, or lapsed-payer reactivation — pick the one you want as the flagship KPI), demonstrated through a controlled experiment, not just before/after comparison. Model monitoring in place — drift and staleness alerts mean the team knows within days, not months, if a live model silently degrades. A repeatable model-to-production playbook that others in the team can follow ⌘Skills & Competencies Must have (hard skills) Strong Python for data science and ML (scikit-learn, XGBoost/LightGBM; PyTorch or TensorFlow a plus if deep learning is relevant to future use cases). Proven track record shipping models to production, not just modeling in a notebook. Can talk through at least one model that served live traffic. Hands-on experience with a cloud ML platform, ideally GCP (Vertex AI, BigQuery ML, Cloud Run/Functions) or fast ability to translate equivalent AWS/Azure experience. Solid SQL; comfortable working against a dbt/BigQuery warehouse. Software engineering fundamentals: git, code review, testing, CI/CD: You'll be shipping code Engineering has to trust. Causal inference / uplift modelling or applied experimentation experience: pricing and discounting need "what if we hadn't," not just "who churns." Nice to have Experience with streaming/event pipelines (Pub/Sub, Dataflow, Kafka): useful as we move off pure batch. Experience with pricing, discounting, personalization specifically. Familiarity with feature stores or the DIY equivalent (versioned feature pipelines). Multi-armed bandits or reinforcement learning for pricing/personalization. Startup experience: comfortable being the first person to build something rather than joining an existing ML platform team. Soft skills Genuinely energised by "does this move the metric," not just "is this model accurate." Can hold their own in a room with Engineering and with Business: Speaks commercial as well as the language of engineering Explains modeling tradeoffs in plain business terms to Product/leadership without dumbing it down or using too much jargon Comfortable owning ambiguity — this role is defining the pattern, not following one. ⌘ Required experience 4–7 years in a data scientist / ML engineer role, with at least one model you personally took from prototype to live production serving real users or real traffic. Quantitative background (CS, stats, engineering or equivalent hands-on experience). B2C, subscription, or marketplace

jobs.jd: Senior Data Scientist: Ontology Engineer – Knowledge Architecture, Types and Languages The Ontology Engineer is a foundational, hands-on-keyboard hire on the AI, ML and Data Science team, specializing in Knowledge Representation. You will build the ontological architecture that aligns data across organizations, and connect it to type systems and programming languages. This is not a taxonomy or metadata role: you build working ontologies, schemas, queries and code. A formal background in logic and type theory is a plus. Our platform sits between hospitals, distributors, GPOs, manufacturers and regulators, each with an implicit ontology in its schemas, workflows and data. You will define the structures that align them: auditable, compositionally sound and maintainable for years as their systems evolve. You will work with ontology specialists and domain experts, defend design decisions with working prototypes and evidence, and write the axioms, queries, code and tests yourself. Essential Duties: Design and maintain the ontology: canonical structural layer (organizations, items, contracts, transactions), source data ontologies and the process layer (curation, matching, workflows). Define when records from different systems refer to the same thing, which can differ by use case. Map trading partner data to the canonical ontology, with documented provenance and validity conditions. Author and maintain the ontology in LinkML (classes, constraints, validation, generated artifacts) and manage its lifecycle: quality checks, versioning, releases. Derive typed schemas, interfaces and contracts from the ontology and keep them in sync. Help design and implement domain-specific languages grounded in the ontology (syntax, type rules, semantics), delivered as working prototypes. Discover ontology from data and its uses, not schemas alone. Build and evaluate LLM-assisted extraction pipelines with human-in-the-loop validation. Translate ontology decisions into graph and relational implementations, with SPARQL and graph schemas precise enough to prevent semantic loss. Work with governance, data quality, data engineering, product and domain experts so the architecture supports transactional, clinical and analytical needs. Track ontology, type theory and LLM-assisted knowledge engineering, and drive adoption of better methods. Competencies: Working knowledge of LinkML for ontology and schema modeling, with familiarity with OWL given its prevalence. Knowledge graph proficiency (RDF, SPARQL); familiarity with property graphs (LPG, Cypher) and how their semantics differ from RDF. Practical understanding of type systems and language design, and how they relate to an ontology. Data integration: schema matching, entity resolution, multi-source alignment; reading profiling results (functional and inclusion dependencies) as ontological signals. Clear communication with both business stakeholders and engineers. Comfort with incomplete models, documenting what remains unspecified. Works with minimal supervision. Required Qualifications and Skills: Hands on keyboard: you write production-quality code daily. Proficiency in Python (or similar) and at least one statically typed language (e.g. Scala, Rust, OCaml, TypeScript). More than 4 years in knowledge engineering, ontology development or a closely related discipline. Built and maintained domain ontologies or schemas in LinkML (or OWL/Protégé or equivalent), with automated validation. Experience with automated quality checks, versioning and releases for ontologies or schemas (e.g. LinkML tooling, ROBOT, ODK). Expertise in SPARQL and/or Cypher, with queries that reflect ontological intent. Experience turning data profiling output into ontological claims, and discovering ontology from data as well as designing it top-down. Experience directing or evaluating LLM-assisted knowledge extraction, with clear validation standards. Experience in multi-disciplinary teams integrating technical and domain knowledge. Preferred Qualifications and Skills: Designed or implemented a DSL, type checker, parser, compiler or interpreter; experience with proof assistants or type-theory tooling (e.g. Lean, Cedar, Coq, Agda). Formal background: description logics, upper ontology theory (e.g. BFO) and type theory. Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Philosophy (logic), Information Science or a related discipline. Category theory applied to data integration (functors, limits and colimits as schema merge); CQL/AQL a plus. OBO Foundry principles. Healthcare supply chain domain knowledge. Provenance models (why, how, where) in ontology-aligned systems. Production graph databases (e.g. Stardog, Amazon Neptune). Sense of humor.   • Unlimted AI Tokens We are ready to invest in AI and will equip you with all the tools and accesses you need to create 1000x results

  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

jobs.location: San Jose, California, United States of America
jobs.jd:
The Company PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers. We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities. Job Summary: This job will assist in designing, developing, and implementing machine learning models and algorithms to solve complex problems. You will work closely with senior engineers, data scientists, and product teams to enhance services through innovative AI/ML solutions. Your role will involve building scalable ML pipelines, ensuring data quality, and deploying models into production environments to drive business insights and improve customer experiences. Job Description: Essential Responsibilities: Assist in the development and optimization of machine learning models. Preprocess and analyze datasets to ensure data quality. Collaborate with senior engineers and data scientists on model deployment. Conduct experiments and run machine learning tests. Stay updated with the latest advancements in machine learning. Minimum Qualifications: 1+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience. Familiarity with ML frameworks like TensorFlow or scikit-learn. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications : Preferred Qualifications: Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related field, with coursework or a thesis in machine learning Hands-on ML experience through internships, research or substantial projects, shown in a portfolio, GitHub or publications Highly skilled with agentic coding tools and workflows (for example, Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot) to build, test and ship ML code faster Experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow; working knowledge of SQL and large-scale data tools such as Spark or BigQuery Experience with at least one of: recommender systems and ranking, NLP, or deep learning for sequential or user-behavior data Exposure to LLMs and agentic systems, such as retrieval-augmented generation, fine-tuning, prompt design or building LLM evaluations Familiarity with taking models toward production: model serving, APIs, containers (Docker) or cloud ML platforms such as AWS SageMaker Understanding of experiment design and A/B testing, and how offline metrics relate to online business outcomes Publications at highly recognized conferences (for example NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, KDD, RecSys, ACL or EMNLP); other research contributions such as workshop papers, Kaggle results or open-source work are also valued Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical partners Curiosity about payments, fintech or consumer products Subsidiary: PayPal Travel Percent: 0 - The base pay for this role will depend on where you work and the relevant experience and expertise you bring. Title and Summary Senior / Lead AI Engineer Senior / Lead AI Engineer - Foundry R&D, Singapore We are looking for a Senior / Lead AI Engineer to be part of The Mastercard Foundry R&D team. You will be part of the team that drives Mastercard's innovation journey by consistently looking to discover and learn new skills and technologies and apply them to create highly scalable products. The ideal candidate is passionate about technology, willing to experiment, agile, highly motivated, intellectually curious, analytical, and possesses an entrepreneurial mindset. What you'll do * Drive Generative AI Innovation: Lead the design and development of advanced AI solutions and proof-of-concepts focused on generative AI (e.g. LLMs, GANs). jobs.title: Master Thesis on Robust Agentic HEMS Control using Time-Series Foundation Models via MCP
jobs.jd: Modern Home Energy Management Systems (HEMS) face the challenge of translating complex user requests into concrete, dependable system actions. While state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs) are advancing rapidly in reasoning, multi-modal comprehension, and tool usage, high-precision quantitative modeling of physical signals remains computationally demanding. Specialized Time-Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) offer compelling complementary capabilities for modeling complex numerical curve dynamics, opening up exciting opportunities to explore where and how TSFMs can most effectively support LLM-driven agents. In this Master's thesis, you will research a robust, closed-loop agentic framework where an LLM agent interacts with specialized time-series foundation models via the standardized Model Context Protocol (MCP) to analyze, safeguard, and optimize HEMS operations. The thesis can emphasize one or more of the following research directions: Closed-Loop Control & Dynamic Forecasting: Interactive feedback loops for iterative parameter optimization and trajectory simulation. Anomaly Detection & System Guardrails: Real-time identification of abnormal consumption, device faults, and operational constraints. Data Quality & Smart Imputation: Generative zero-shot reconstruction of missing sensor time-series to ensure dependable downstream operation. During your 6-month thesis, your work will focus on the following key areas: During your assignment, you will connect a specialized Time-Series Foundation Model (TSFM) as an independent service to an existing LLM agent ecosystem using the standardized Model Context Protocol (MCP). You will investigate how numerical time-series outputs generated by the TSFM (predictions, reconstructed values, anomaly scores) can be mathematically abstracted at the server level into concise semantic representations tailored for LLM reasoning. Additionally, you will design an interactive evaluation loop where the agent proposes parameter actions, evaluates the model's simulated response or safety feedback, and converges on optimal, robust control decisions. Finally, you will systematically evaluate scenarios and data representations to determine where specialized TSFMs deliver measurable advantages over pure LLM reasoning in terms of computational efficiency, token consumption, latency, and predictive accuracy. Education: master studies in the field of Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics or comparable with good grades Experience and Knowledge: strong proficiency in Python (especially familiarity with data and time-series processing libraries such as Pandas and NumPy, as well as modern asynchronous frameworks like asyncio); theoretical and practical grounding in machine learning (ideally time-series models / foundation models); solid understanding of modular software architectures and network interfaces Personality and Working Practice: you are highly self-motivated, using your strong analytical skills to drive independent scientific research Work Routine: we offer you the opportunity to work in a hybrid setup Enthusiasm: strong interest in agentic workflows, tool-calling mechanisms and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) Language: very good in English or German Start: according to prior agreement Duration: 6 months Requirement for this thesis is the enrollment at university. jobs.title: Senior Threat Research Engineer, Security Factory: Threat Research
jobs.location: Remote, Israel; Remote, Poland; Remote, United Kingdom
jobs.jd:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a senior researcher in GitLab's Threat Research group, you'll turn emerging security threats into protection for GitLab customers. You'll lead your own research projects, taking ideas from the first question to a working proof of concept, deploying it, and analyzing the results. You'll also keep the detection systems you build running in production.

Artificial intelligence (AI) is central to how we work. We build agentic workflows for research, analysis, and detection, and use AI tools every day to move faster. This is a full-stack research role: you'll combine an adversarial mindset with the software engineering skills to build and operate the systems behind your work.

What you’ll do

  • Lead your own research projects, from the first idea to the published result.
  • Research new attack surfaces and threat vectors, including AI coding agents, agent plugins, and package ecosystems.
  • Find and responsibly disclose vulnerabilities in open source projects and developer tools.
  • Analyze supply chain incidents and events.
  • Build AI-powered workflows and agents that automate research, analysis, and detection.
  • Build and maintain the cloud-based systems behind our detection and advisory work.
  • Improve the quality and coverage of our vulnerability and malware advisories.
  • Write up your findings as blog posts and present them at conferences.

What you’ll bring

  • Hands-on security experience in research, malware analysis, penetration testing, or security tooling, with published findings such as Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) records, responsible disclosures, blog posts, or talks.
  • Experience researching AI agents, large language model (LLM) applications, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and using AI in real work through LLM application programming interfaces (APIs) or agent frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or agent software development kits (SDKs).
  • The ability to build systems and assess how to break them, with strong Go or Python skills and practices including testing, code review, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), and maintainable code.
  • Experience deploying and running production services on a public cloud.
  • An understanding of package ecosystems and supply chain attacks, informed by current security and AI industry trends.
  • The ability to map attack vectors, explain trade-offs, and use data to move experiments forward while balancing quality, speed, and customer outcomes.
  • Clear writing that explains findings to both engineers and a general audience.
  • Helpful but not required: Google Cloud Platform (GCP) experience, infrastructure as code with Terraform or OpenTofu, databases or data pipelines at scale, and reverse engineering.

You don't need deep knowledge of compilers or static application security testing (SAST) engines. A high-level understanding is enough.

You don't have to match every listed requirement exactly to be considered. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.

About the team

The Threat Research group at GitLab researches security threats as they emerge and turns what we learn into protection for GitLab customers. We maintain the GitLab Advisory Database, which powers GitLab's dependency scanning. We also build detection capabilities, do original vulnerability research, and publish what we find. Recent work includes the Shai-Hulud npm worm and a critical RCE in Serena, a popular MCP coding agent. More on the Security Labs blog.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Growth Alliance (all genders)
jobs.jd:
At HelloFresh, the goal is to change the way people eat forever by delivering high-quality food across 18 countries and 3 continents. As a global food solutions group and the world's leading meal kit provider, the portfolio includes HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate, Chefs Plate, Factor_, and Youfoodz.

Engaging with HelloFresh in Warsaw means collaborating with HelloTech-a global technology division of over 1,000 people powering an end-to-end food ecosystem. From digital personalization, pricing, and forecasting to supply chain optimization and food waste reduction, technology drives every step of this direct-to-consumer model.

About the Role: What's in the Box

HelloTech operates in autonomous, cross-functional alliances, each holding accountability for a specific product domain end to end. In this role, you will join an assigned squad, with the flexibility to transition between teams and projects as technical objectives and business priorities evolve.

Several high-impact machine learning domains are actively hiring, and your project and team placement will be aligned based on your individual strengths, interests, and expertise during the interview process. Key domains include:

  • Risk, Fraud & Payments (Growth Alliance): You will own production ML systems that protect HelloFresh from checkout fraud and intelligently recover failed recurring payments (such as Smart Payment Retry) via low-latency scoring on Databricks.
  • Personalization & Conversions (Growth Alliance): You will build real-time decisioning systems, customer win-back models, and scalable GenAI content pipelines that tailor journeys and messaging across visitor and customer funnels.
  • Dynamic Pricing & Customer Value Optimization (Growth Alliance): You will architect and scale the core Pricing Engine to drive pricing optimization and forecasting across 8 brands, 34 markets, and all weekly menus.

Across all domains, you will work on scalable, high-availability production ML systems serving global architectures. Please note that this is an individual contributor role and does not include people management responsibilities.

What You’ll Do: The Recipe

At HelloFresh, we are moving away from a model where engineers simply execute tickets toward one where product engineers are trusted to own customer problems. As a Product Engineer, you will take a problem, form a point of view, validate it with customers and data, and ship it using AI as a force multiplier.

  • Build and operate data products and machine-learning systems, taking them from experimentation through production and owning their real-world performance.
  • Architect and optimize scalable batch and streaming data pipelines (Python, SQL, PySpark on Databricks, Kafka), feature stores, and low-latency serving infrastructure.
  • Improve inference performance, reliability, and compute cost by profiling bottlenecks, right-sizing infrastructure, and maintaining tight latency targets with dependable fallback mechanisms.
  • Establish and raise modern MLOps standards across teams, including CI/CD automation, model registry versioning, infrastructure as code (Terraform), automated validation gates, and drift detection.
  • Design and execute rigorous experimentation frameworks from A/B tests and holdouts to off-policy evaluation-to credibly measure model impact on core business metrics.
  • Build and scale domain-specific applied AI solutions, ranging from real-time scoring and contextual bandits to production GenAI pipelines with automated quality gates.
  • Collaborate closely with data scientists, software engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to pressure-test models for production readiness, mentor teammates, and leverage AI coding agents (such as Claude Code or Cursor) to accelerate engineering delivery.

What You’ll Bring: The Ingredients

  • 5+ years building and operating live ML systems in production, paired with the statistical literacy to design sound experiments and interpret their results.
  • Hands-on experience building product-facing ML solutions directly tied to measurable business metrics (such as conversion, retention, revenue, or risk reduction).
  • Deep command of Python, SQL, and large-scale data processing (PySpark on Databricks), paired with solid software engineering practices (testing, clean code, version control) and familiarity with low-latency serving or backend languages like Go.
  • Hands-on background with cloud environments (AWS), containerization, automated CI/CD, and modern ML or orchestration tooling such as Databricks Model Serving, MLflow, SageMaker, Airflow, Kafka, or Terraform.
  • Practical, day-to-day fluency with AI coding tools (like Claude Code, Cursor, or Copilot) beyond casual experimentation—knowing how to structure context and set clear boundaries on AI-generated work.
  • A quality-first mindset around model evaluation, drift monitoring, and A/B testing pitfalls for ML systems to ensure bad data or outputs never reach customers.
  • A bias to ship ("finishing the last twenty percent"), strong product sense backed by data, and clear communication skills across international, multi-disciplinary teams.

Nice to have:

  • A track record of optimizing data and ML pipelines for performance and cost at scale.
  • Experience with contextual bandits and off-policy evaluation.
  • Hands-on experience building and running production LLM pipelines.
  • Background in churn prediction and Customer Lifetime Value (LTV) modeling.
  • Prior experience in high-growth consumer tech or subscription-based businesses.

jobs.jd: NVIDIA has helped redefine what computers can do. Now, generative AI is opening new possibilities for how people learn, create, and tackle problems. Your curiosity and scientific judgment can shape what we test, what we learn, and what we build next. We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer / AI Researcher / Data Scientist to join our AI Safety and Responsibility efforts within Enterprise Risk Management. You will turn open research questions into rigorous benchmarks, inventive experiments, and tools that reveal how multimodal large language models behave under pressure. Working with researchers and platform engineers, you’ll connect those discoveries to better training methods and safeguards, with reproducible results that inform technical reviews and executive decisions. If you love asking the question no one has thought to test, and building a convincing way to answer it, come help us define what progress in AI safety looks like. Evaluation Methodology: Define metrics and protocols that assess safety alongside model usefulness, using baselines, uncertainty estimates, and failure analysis to distinguish meaningful improvements from noise. Reproducible Evaluation: Build reusable Python pipelines with versioned datasets, model configurations, and experiment tracking to reproduce results and compare performance across model releases. Automated Red-Teaming: Develop tools to discover failure modes and expand evaluation coverage, incorporating human review to validate automated scoring and provide additional judgment. Failure Analysis: Investigate model failures with researchers, document actionable findings, and develop regression tests to assess whether model changes resolve identified issues. Results and Communication: Partner with platform engineers to store and aggregate evaluation results, and clearly communicate findings, limitations, and emerging risks to researchers and decision-makers. What We Need To See: Education and Experience: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, with 6+ years in the field of machine learning engineering or evaluation. Evaluation Design: Experience developing benchmarks, metrics, and statistically sound comparisons for ML systems, including selecting baselines and interpreting uncertainty. Ability to translate ambiguous evaluation questions into testable experiments. Engineering: Strong Python skills and experience building maintainable shared tools, data pipelines, and experiment-tracking workflows. Analytical Rigor: Ability to assess dataset quality, identify limitations in metrics and scoring methods, and support conclusions with reproducible evidence. Communication: Clearly explain findings and tradeoffs to researchers, engineering partners, and executives. Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd: Evaluation: Experience evaluating LLMs, multimodal models, or agentic systems through adversarial testing or automated red-teaming. Community Contributions: Contributions to public benchmarks or evaluation frameworks. Research Publications: A publication track record and interest in continuing to publish at top tier venues. Statistical Rigor: Strong model evaluation skills and a commitment to sound statistical practices, including confidence intervals. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline and portfolio of medicines to treat heart disease, obesity and obesity-related conditions, rare diseases, inflammatory conditions and cancer. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives. Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Build and integrate MCP servers and tools to connect AI solutions with enterprise data, applications, and services. Evaluate and monitor AI solutions and data products for accuracy, reliability, security, and business value. Assess emerging AI technologies and engineering practices, recommending approaches based on technical fit and implementation impact What we expect of you We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The dynamic professional we seek is a collaborative partner with these qualifications.
